description: This file implements the SHA-1 cryptographic hash algorithm, including class definition, methods for initialization, updating, padding, processing, and digest retrieval, as well as utility functions for hashing strings and byte arrays.

classes.name: SecureHashAlgorithm
classes.description: Class implementing the SHA-1 hashing algorithm with methods for initialization, data update, finalization, and digest retrieval.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the SHA-1 state variables and internal buffers.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the hash with new data chunks.

methods.name: Final
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, performing padding and processing.

methods.name: Digest
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current message digest.
